layoutUnderTest: Caption line wrapping with a 58-character petitioner name and a generational suffix.
Other-names-used list running to five entries across multiple lines.
Two-line street address with unit and building designators.
Verification block and counsel signature block both sitting under a wrapped name.
additionalFacts: The petition must be filed with the circuit clerk on the same day and during the same hearing in which the case is disposed.
If the petition is not filed during the hearing, ordinary sealing under § 5.2(c)(3)(A) remains available at any time through il-seal-nonconv.
